component.name: Junk Drawer
component.summary: A small file manager for Hyprland, in Catppuccin colours

description.p: Certified, artisanal, vibe-coded slop: an AI wrote all of it while a person said "yeah, looks good" and pressed Enter a lot. It really does copy, move and delete files, so if you're fond of yours, use a file manager made by people who know what they're doing.
Still here? Junk Drawer is a minimal GTK 4 file manager for tiling Wayland setups:

ul.li: An icon grid with thumbnails and a details list
A sidebar with places, bookmarks and removable drives
Copy, move, drag and drop, trash, and a name-clash dialog
All four Catppuccin flavors, or your GTK theme's colours
Every action bound to keys you can change

screenshot.caption: The icon view, with thumbnails and the sidebar
